ios.desc:
"Great for improving your speech in any situation!"
– missbrisket (Feb 27, 2026)

*Find your voice with Astound*

Speaking with confidence doesn't come naturally to most of us. Whether it's leading a meeting, pitching an idea, teaching a class, or recording a podcast — your voice carries more weight than you think.
And yet, very few of us ever receive real training on how to use it. That's why we built Astound.

Most users notice a real shift within just a few days of practice: greater calm, more confidence, stronger presence. With daily recordings, you can hear your own progress as it happens.

We know speaking can feel nerve-racking — even when it's not a big stage. That shaky feeling before you present? You're not alone. Astound helps you turn those nerves into calm energy and presence.

*Our approach is different*
Instead of obsessing over filler words, we focus on how your voice makes you — and your listeners — feel. You'll learn to breathe with intention, speak with authenticity, and adapt your voice to fit any room.
With 100+ bite-sized exercises, guided breathing techniques, voice recordings, affirmations, and progress tracking, daily practice becomes simple, approachable, and even something to look forward to.
Your voice is your power. Astound teaches you how to use it.

-----------------------

What's inside
- 100+ easy-to-follow video tutorials
- A 30-Day Challenge that gradually builds your voice toward your chosen goal
- Practice packs for specific moments — job interviews, presentations, podcasts, and more

Features
- Audio Voice Recorder
- Feedback and analytics on your tempo, pitch, and volume
- Favorite exercises for quick access
- Daily reminders to build a lasting habit

*Subscription pricing*
Full access to everything Astound offers:
- $12.99/month
- $79.99/year — that's 49% off, under $7/month

Prices shown for US customers. Local pricing may vary.
